_comment: 2026-11-26 readout mine, round 3 batch D: remaining estimate rechecks plus two new companies, red-teamed against each company's own release or filing (registry record for the CSTL misattribution). Applied by apply_1126_readout_mine.py with READOUT_MINE_FILE.
curator_notes: Interim data releases (HUMA V012, CRDF CRDF-004, LXEO HEROIC-PKP2, RYTM PWS Phase 2) do not retire the registry estimate, which tracks the trial's primary completion; those estimates stay.
ANVS: the March 2027 topline is the 6-month symptomatic readout of DUET-AD; the registry estimate (2027-12) is the 18-month readout, so both stay.
CSTL FCX-007: the registry sponsor of NCT06892639 is Castle Creek Biosciences (private), not Castle Biosciences; the estimate was misattributed and leaves the list.

rows.quote: ... database lock on February 8, 2027, with topline results in March 2027.
rows.notes: Company also plans to present 6-month data at AD/PD 2027 (Barcelona); 18-month disease-modifying readout undated. NCT06709014 is the Phase 3 early AD study
rows.rt_reason: Opened the Nov 13 2026 GlobeNewswire Q3 release: it says '...database lock on February 8, 2027, with topline results in March 2027' for the DUET-AD 6-month symptomatic analysis (862 early AD patients) and plans AD/PD 2027 presentation. NCT06709014 is DUET-AD (Annovis, Phase 3, early AD), the same trial. Note: the registry's primary completion 2027-12 reflects the 18-month endpoint, and the company gives no date for the 18-month readout. Nov 17 and Nov 20 releases do not change the timing.

rows.quote: Top-line data from the twin Phase 3 ENSURE-1 and ENSURE-2 trials remains on track ... is expected to be available in December 2026
rows.notes: NCT05134441 is one of the twin ENSURE trials; both guided to December 2026
rows.rt_reason: Opened the Immunic Q3 release of Nov 13 2026: 'Top-line data from the twin Phase 3 ENSURE-1 and ENSURE-2 trials remains on track ... is expected to be available in December 2026.' NCT05134441 is ENSURE-1 (IMU-838, RMS), the same trial as the estimate. No newer IMUX release through Nov 26 per FMP; data not yet reported.

rows.quote: we have decided to discontinue internal development of TransCon IL-2 β/γ in Oncology
rows.notes: Q1 2026 results release; company will explore other ways to maximize the asset's value. NCT05081609 is IL-BELIEVE
rows.rt_reason: Opened the Ascendis Q1 2026 release (May 7 2026): 'we have decided to discontinue internal development of TransCon IL-2 β/γ in Oncology and will explore other ways to maximize the value of this asset', in the IL-BELIEVE context. ASND is still listed on Nasdaq.

rows.readout: program rights returned; no longer a Taysha program
rows.quote: transferred rights back to Queen's University (Queen's) for TSHA-101 in GM2 gangliosidosis
rows.notes: Trial (NCT04798235) may continue under Queen's University, but Taysha is no longer the sponsor; row probably should drop TSHA
rows.rt_reason: Opened the Taysha IR release (Feb 15 2024): 'The Company transferred rights back to Queen's University (Queen's) for TSHA-101 in GM2 gangliosidosis...'. The registry record NCT04798235 now lists Dr. Anupam Sehgal (Queen's) as sponsor and Taysha only as collaborator, so it is no longer a Taysha program.

rows.indication: lupus nephritis and refractory systemic lupus erythematosus
rows.readout: development discontinued; no further dosing in any ongoing AlloNK study
rows.quote: No additional patients will be dosed in any ongoing AlloNK clinical study and the planned Phase 3 pivotal trial will not be initiated.
rows.notes: Company will discontinue further development of AlloNK and close out the clinical program; NCT06265220 is an AlloNK study
rows.rt_reason: Opened the Artiva IR release (Oct 27 2026): it will 'discontinue further development of AlloNK (AB-101)', 'No additional patients will be dosed in any ongoing AlloNK clinical study' and the clinical program will be closed out. The release names RA and 'other B-cell-driven autoimmune diseases', not lupus by name, but NCT06265220 is the Artiva-sponsored AB-101 LN/SLE study, so it is covered by 'any ongoing AlloNK clinical study'.

rows.indication: advanced solid tumors (HCC, CRC and others)
rows.trial: Phase 1b/2 Decoy20 with or without tislelizumab
rows.readout: no participants remain in any active Decoy20 study
rows.quote: there are no participants remaining in any active Decoy20 clinical study
rows.notes: From an S-3 registration statement (form not in the usual list); no data timing given. NCT05651022 is the Decoy20 +/- tislelizumab study
rows.rt_reason: Opened the Indaptus S-3 (company's own filing, Aug 17 2026): it 'discontinued further enrollment' in the tislelizumab combination study and 'there are no participants remaining in any active Decoy20 clinical study'. The Nov 13 2026 Q3 release confirms 'the discontinuation and wind-down of Decoy20 clinical activities'. NCT05651022 is the Decoy20 +/- tislelizumab study. INDP is still listed on Nasdaq.

rows.quote: With topline data from both our global 4WARD trial and our new 4STEPS trial expected in the first quarter of 2028
rows.rt_reason: Opened the X4 Q3 release (Nov 4 2026, 16:15 ET): CEO quote 'With topline data from both our global 4WARD trial and our new 4STEPS trial expected in the first quarter of 2028'. 4WARD is the global pivotal Phase 3 of mavorixafor in (primary) chronic neutropenia. XFOR currently trades on Nasdaq, and there is no newer XFOR release.

rows.quote: With topline data from both our global 4WARD trial and our new 4STEPS trial expected in the first quarter of 2028
rows.rt_reason: Same Nov 4 2026 X4 release: 4STEPS is a planned Phase 2b (about 25 patients, G-CSF dose reduction with mavorixafor), first participant expected Q1 2027, and 'topline data expected in the first quarter of 2028.' XFOR is listed on Nasdaq.

rows.quote: with topline data expected by year-end 2027
rows.notes: quote is a clause of a longer sentence; release date taken from the Business Wire URL
rows.rt_reason: Opened the Obsidian Q3 release on Business Wire (FMP shows it published 2026-11-12 16:05): 'complete enrollment in the registration-enabling cohort by the end of the first quarter of 2027 and report topline data by year-end 2027' for the ICI-resistant advanced melanoma cohort of Agni-01. Year precision ending 2027-12-31 fits the convention. OBX has traded on Nasdaq since Aug 4 2026, and the Nov 23 release does not change the timing.

rows.quote: NSCLC Phase 1 data are expected in the first half of 2027.
rows.notes: release date taken from the Business Wire URL
rows.rt_reason: Same Nov 12 2026 Obsidian release: 'Obsidian is also investigating amsoki-cel in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in the Agni-01 trial. NSCLC Phase 1 data are expected in the first half of 2027.' OBX is listed on Nasdaq.

rows.notes: Proposed removal: FCX-007 (D-Fi) is Castle Creek Biosciences' product (private company), not Castle Biosciences (CSTL). Check the registry sponsor of NCT06892639 and whether CSTL has any interest in FCX-007.
rows.rt_reason: The registry record NCT06892639 (D-Fi/FCX-007, Phase 3, DEB) lists 'Castle Creek Biosciences, LLC.' as sponsor, with Prosoft Clinical as the only collaborator. Castle Biosciences (CSTL, Nasdaq) is a diagnostics company (DecisionDx gene-expression tests) per its profile, and nothing links it to FCX-007. The removal is correct.
